data.summary: The Web-Prototype directory contains static HTML mockups and shared assets for a redesign of the Sandbox manager's web interface. It includes five page prototypes (overview, create, models, list, workspace) alongside a shared stylesheet and a JavaScript shell that together demonstrate the new design system, theming, and iconography.

file_insights.name: index.html
file_insights.summary: Prototype overview page linking to all redesigned screens of the Sandbox manager.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains HTML structure with a header, lede paragraph, and a grid of screen preview cards. Inline styles define the .lede and .screens layout using CSS variables from mgr-web.css.
file_insights.detailed_description: Serves as the entry point for the Web-Prototype directory, presenting a grid of links to the individual HTML mockups (create-sandbox, models, sandbox-list, workspace). It sets the visual theme from localStorage and loads the shared stylesheet.
responsibilities: Provide navigation to all prototype screens

file_insights.name: create-sandbox.html
file_insights.summary: Prototype page for creating a new sandbox with form and side panel.
file_insights.source_summary: HTML skeleton with a .wz grid container, form fields, and aside content. Inline <style> block defines .wz and .wz-form display properties.
file_insights.detailed_description: Mockup of the sandbox creation workflow, featuring a two-column layout (.wz) with a form area and a 312px sidebar. It includes inline styles for layout and likely form controls defined in the shared CSS.
responsibilities: Show side panel with guidance or summary

file_insights.name: models.html
file_insights.summary: Prototype page for configuring model parameters and profiles.
file_insights.source_summary: HTML structure with a profile bar section and other configuration panels. Inline <style> defines .profile-bar flex layout and spacing.
file_insights.detailed_description: Displays a profile bar and likely model-specific settings. Uses inline styles for .profile-bar layout and relies on shared styles for form controls and cards.

file_insights.name: sandbox-list.html
file_insights.summary: Prototype page listing all sandboxes with toolbar and filtering controls.
file_insights.source_summary: HTML with a toolbar section containing inputs and buttons, followed by a list of sandbox items. Inline <style> block styles .toolbar and its child elements.
file_insights.detailed_description: Shows a list view of sandboxes with a toolbar for search, filtering, and actions. Inline styles define .toolbar layout and input sizing.

file_insights.name: workspace.html
file_insights.summary: Prototype page for the sandbox workspace, likely the main interaction area.
file_insights.source_summary: HTML with a workspace search section and a grid area. Inline <style> block includes .ws-search padding and .gl-empty styling.
file_insights.detailed_description: The workspace page where users interact with a sandbox, containing a search pane and a grid layout. Inline styles define .ws-search and .gl-empty for specific workspace components.

file_insights.name: mgr-web.css
file_insights.summary: Shared stylesheet defining design tokens and component styles for the prototype.
file_insights.source_summary: CSS with :root token definitions, an @import for Inter font, and component rules. Tokens include --bg, --surface, --fg, --muted, --border, etc. Dark mode overrides are likely under [data-mode='light'] or similar.
file_insights.detailed_description: Contains Cloudflare Kumo semantic design tokens (colors, spacing, typography) as CSS custom properties, imported from the real mgr-web app. Component classes for the redesign are defined, all using var(--*) for theming, with dark mode via [data-mode] overrides.
responsibilities: Provide component styles for all prototype pages
Enable theme switching via data-mode attribute

file_insights.name: mgr-shell.js
file_insights.summary: Shared JavaScript that injects SVG icon sprites, renders the icon rail, and manages theme persistence.
file_insights.source_summary: Contains a P helper for path elements, an ICONS object with cube, grid, etc., and logic to create the sprite and rail. Uses localStorage for theme persistence.
file_insights.detailed_description: An IIFE that defines an ICONS object mapping icon names to SVG paths, injects an SVG sprite into the DOM, renders a 48px icon rail matching the app's sidebar, and reads/writes the theme to localStorage under 'mgr.theme' setting data-mode on <html>.
